arguments.value: User reports Xubuntu 20.04.6 with Firefox and a non-snap Chromium installed. After removing the Chromium snap and installing Chromium from Linux Mint repos, opening links from Thunderbird or other apps fails with "Failed to execute default Web Browser. Input/output error." Chromium itself launches from the menu and is set as the default browser, but external link handling still fails. User asks which config file controls the default web browser, whether editing it is the recommended fix, or if there is a tool to set it.
